references.text: The command to love the Lord your God with all your heart, all your soul, and all your strength is the foundation of faithfulness to God.
The same exhortation to fear the Lord, walk in his ways, love him, and serve him with all your heart.
Reiterates the requirement to follow the Lord, fear him, keep his commands, and hold fast to him.
Loving the Lord, obeying him, and staying close to him is the source of life and blessing.
Joshua exhorts the people to love the Lord, walk in his ways, keep his commands, and hold fast to him.
The exhortation to hold fast to the Lord, as the people had done until that day.
The psalmist expresses his longing to stay close to God and be upheld by his right hand.
The psalmist holds fast to God's testimonies and does not wish to be put to shame.
Jesus quotes the greatest commandment to love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, and mind.
Jesus says that love for him is shown by keeping his commands.
Keeping Jesus' commands is the sign of remaining in his love.
Love for God is shown by keeping his commands, and his commands are not burdensome.
